1339-2034-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2034-7920.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

2577-4826-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

7084-7889-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4435-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

943-2203-2597-3756-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-3756-4235.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Izzet Boilerworks.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7175-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

129-1409-3755-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
129-1409-3755-4068.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5570-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
4050-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3378-3821-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3378-3821-7487.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3378-3821-7487.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2149-2440-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Zaffai
1618-2149-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Zaffai triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2149-2440-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1870-3609-7280.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an artifact into your graveyard from the battlefield.
1870-3609-7280.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. It will enter with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield. When it does, Donatello triggers, putting a number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter equal to the number Eternity Vessel had on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 3 as able each turn.
1870-3609-7280.notes: The total number of turns you will get is equal to: (your life total + the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter)/3, rounded down.

628-2193-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

579-1144-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya, and adding another {G} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Walls of Ba Sing Se

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to The Walls of Ba Sing Se

1055-3525-7059.description:
Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by tapping it, causing a player to mill thirty cards.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping The Walls of Ba Sing Se.
Repeat as mana allows.
1055-3525-7059.notes: This combo can be repeated each turn as mana allows.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1603-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Evil Twin.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evil Twin by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2866-4986-5034-5226.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

4321-4452-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure and Food token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

643-4508-4772-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

804-2533-4681-5686.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

2973-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2973-6191.description:
Gain life.
Dina triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Bloodthirsty Conqueror trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4050-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2557-4050-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

186-304-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-304-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tough Cookie's first activated ability by paying {2}{G}, making Basalt Monolith a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2249-2329.notablePrerequisites: Spike Breeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2249-2329.description:
Activate Spike Breeder's second ability by paying {2} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spike creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spike, adding {C}{C}.
When the Spike dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spike Breeder.
Repeat.

262-2741-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-2741-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Essence Warden three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

644-1048-1267-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Triton Shorestalker does not have summoning sickness.
644-1048-1267-4600-5241.description:
Declare Triton Shorestalker as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Triton Shorestalker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Triton Shorestalker by paying {U}.
Equilibrium triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
